baseline_identity_correction.original_claim_too_strong: The newly rebuilt baseline is not the earlier delivered binary bytes.
baseline_identity_correction.corrected_interpretation: The original 311 image was not reused. The independent e020 original-PGO rebuild actually produced an identical runtime binary SHA256 to the 311 actual root image. Image identity and binary byte identity are different claims.
baseline_identity_correction.comparison_limit: This does not make the older 969 comparison directly comparable: host changed from AMD EPYC 9V45 to Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C, policy is fixed here, and long phases have 1000 rather than 64 requests.

ratio_definition: Median of paired baseline/candidate elapsed times; >1 means faster candidate. AB is baseline then candidate; BA is candidate then baseline. Group medians are not weighted into a total score.
windows: 1000 requests per phase for standard10k/resident30k/filter60k, independently retaining first, front64, after64. Spill phases have64; projection cases retain all7 phases and3 repeats.

decisions.equality: Reject default adoption: small standard filtered gains are not stable across every seed/order; filter60k restart seed13337 remains0.916077 and A/A is broad. 30k does not exercise this path and tracks A/A. Protection negatives remain, including all3 spill-high before queries and all3 many16 wide-large queries.
decisions.dom: Reject default adoption: many16 wide-all0.982315 and narrow-all0.986469 are slower in all3 seeds; many16 total1.041826 does not establish a serialization gain. filter60k before0.967535 with11/15 slower and restart0.983354 with8/15 slower. Other protection negatives are retained.
decisions.runtime_source: Remove both failed optional branches from current runtime source; preserve exact experimental code at76 and in raw build snapshots. Default four production features and original PGO remain. Historical harness must not silently rerun against missing feature implementations.
decisions.next_round: Bulk-output candidate preparation only; still experimental/off, no new measurements in this archive. Any later default adoption requires actual root-image validation.

limitations: All138 identities and samples remain. No negative sample or startup outlier is removed; all negative phase medians are indexed here, full per-pair/seed/order/resources remain in analysis and raw ZIP.
A/A measures same-binary process/host variability, not independent PGO-build variance. It cannot prove a negative pair is noise or prove a proposed mechanism.
Three-pair protection screens give limited coverage; no general benefit or absence-of-regression claim.
Phase lifecycle/accounted totals are sums of reported timers, not complete end-to-end wall time. They include ingestion/other phases and must not be called pure output speedup.
The new host is Intel Xeon Platinum8573C; the earlier120 host was AMD EPYC9V45. Do not subtract or multiply new e020-relative ratios with old969-relative ratios to claim .919/.979 recovered.
Source/profile and symbol-layout changes are not isolated causal performance evidence. Fixed thread counts alone are not a per-request scheduling trace.
Root validation, synthetic analyzer checks, read-only artifact analysis and actual measured runtime gates are separate evidence scopes.
